description: Fix tests/test_opencode_integration.py::test_activate_task_writes_runtime_binding so it captures the pre-state of model-selections.json and restores it in the finally block, with a regression assertion that the runtime overlay is byte-identical after the test runs.
acceptance_criteria: The test captures the pre-state of model-selections.json (bytes or sha256) before the subprocess activation runs.
The finally block restores model-selections.json to that pre-state, including the case where the file did not exist before.
A new regression assertion verifies the restoration (fails before the fix, passes after it).
After running the test module, no TEST-OPENCODE payload remains in any real overlay file and every pre-existing overlay file is byte-identical (permission audit append-only excepted).
